title: 📢 Newark graduation rate hits 92%, four high schools at 100%
text:
21 hours ago 📢 Newark graduation rate hits 92%, four schools at 100%
Newark Public Schools announced that the Class of 2026 reached a record 92% graduation rate , up from 76% in 2018 and 90% in 2025 .
Four high schools reached 100% graduation in 2026 :
Bard High School Early College – Newark Newark School of Data Science & Information Technology Newark School of Fashion & Design Science Park High School Other highlights:
Science Park High School is ranked #16 in New Jersey . Technology High School is ranked #64 in New Jersey . Six schools improved in national rankings, including American History , Arts , Bard Early College – Newark , Newark School of Global Studies , Newark Vocational , and University High . Six comprehensive high schools earned Middle States Accreditation : Barriger, Central, East Side, Malcolm X Shabazz, Weequahic, and West Side High . The district says these gains are part of its 10-year plan, “The Next Decade: 2020–30,” focused on better graduation and more college, career, and trade options for Newark students.
